name: Pamela Bondi
bio: Former Florida Attorney General (2011–2019). Lead Counsel at Law Bookies Chamber with over 25 years of experience in high-stakes litigation, white-collar defense, and government investigations.

notableCases.case: Successfully defended a Fortune 500 CEO in a federal fraud investigation – no charges filed.
Led multi-state opioid settlement negotiations resulting in $26 billion recovery.

name: Michael Sullivan
bio: Former U.S. Attorney for the District of Massachusetts (2001–2009). Specializes in corporate compliance, health care fraud, and internal investigations.

notableCases.case: Secured deferred prosecution agreement for a major pharmaceutical company – $0 fine.
Led internal investigation uncovering $200M fraud; client avoided indictment.

name: Jennifer Chen
bio: Partner-level family law attorney, recognized as a 'Super Lawyer' for 10 consecutive years. Handles complex divorce, child custody, and international family law matters.

notableCases.case: Won $45 million divorce settlement – largest in county history.
Successfully relocated child to China under Hague Convention defense.

name: David Okonkwo
bio: Corporate litigation partner with a focus on shareholder disputes, securities fraud, and antitrust class actions. Frequent lecturer at Columbia Law.

notableCases.case: Obtained $112 million jury verdict in shareholder derivative action.
Defeated class certification in antitrust price-fixing case.
